name: MARVIS_MANUAL_INPUT_V1

validation: fixture exists and kickoff is in the future
all three prices are finite decimal odds greater than 1.0
captured_at is timezone-aware, not future-dated and satisfies existing freshness policy
bookmaker identity is canonicalized without counting one brand twice
player identities are mapped or rejected

workflow: persist only after a separately approved implementation defines audit storage
calculate EV only when valid fresh odds exist
calculate Kelly only after EV exists
emit no BET unless all existing production rules pass

live_states.condition: history/current information sufficient but reliable odds unavailable
validated manual odds and all required live inputs available

security: Never collect account passwords, API keys or payment details.
Never scrape a prohibited source on the user's behalf.
Display manual provenance distinctly from provider data.
Manual entry is not independent corroboration by itself.
